eyeHistories.knownCondition: Microaneurysms in temporal arcade, blot hemorrhages in 2 quadrants, circinate hard exudates near macula.

symptomsList.notes: Symptoms worsening over past 3 months in right eye

clinicalInformationList.familyHistory: Mother had diabetes and visual impairment
clinicalInformationList.notes: Screened at mobile rural camp. Pupils dilated with Tropicamide 0.5%.
